messages.text: I would like a roof clean and a pressure wash
messages.author: customer

messages.text:
Hi there! Thanks for reaching out about our cleaning services. 

For the roof clean, we offer a Roof Soft Wash at £320, which includes a low-pressure biocide treatment to clear moss and prevent regrowth for 12 months. 

For the pressure wash, could you let me know if you’re looking for a driveway or patio clean? We have the Driveway Pressure Wash at £120 (up to 60m²) and the Patio Refresh at £95 (up to 40m²).

Also, it would be great to know the size of the areas you'd like cleaned, any access considerations, and your preferred times for the service. Feel free to send any photos for a more accurate quote!

Looking forward to your reply!

PowWash Team
